title: Resident Evil 2
composer: Masami Ueda, Shusaku Uchiyama, Syun Nishigaki
shortDescription: Hideki Kamiya and Shinji Mikami's survival horror tour de force featuring the zapping system, Raccoon Police Department, and the terrifying Licker.
historicalSignificance: Expanded survival horror into a blockbuster cinematic experience with its interlocking dual-character zapping scenario architecture (Leon Kennedy and Claire Redfield), establishing Capcom's golden formula of tension, resource conservation, and police precinct exploration.

editorialContent.overview: Directed by a young Hideki Kamiya under the guidance of producer Shinji Mikami, Resident Evil 2 debuted in January 1998 after an entire initial version ('Resident Evil 1.5') was famously scrapped when nearly finished. Moving the T-virus outbreak from a secluded mansion into the metropolitan streets of Raccoon City, it established rookie cop Leon S. Kennedy and college student Claire Redfield as enduring video game legends.
editorialContent.gameplay: Employs tank controls across evocative pre-rendered backgrounds with fixed cinematic camera angles. Players manage a strict inventory grid, solve environmental lockbox puzzles, conserve scarce handgun and shotgun ammunition, and navigate horrific bio-organic weapons including mutated dogs, Lickers, and the relentless T-103 Tyrant (Mr. X).
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Introduced the innovative 'Zapping System' across two discs: decisions, consumed resources, and opened passages in Scenario A dynamically affected the counterpart's playthrough in Scenario B, yielding four distinct narrative permutations.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Resident Evil 2 broke entertainment sales records, grossing over $19 million in its opening US weekend to surpass Hollywood blockbusters. It solidified Capcom as a cinematic storytelling juggernaut.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved across original 2-CD PlayStation releases, the legendary compression miracle N64 cartridge by Angel Studios, and the acclaimed 2019 ground-up remake.

awards: IGN PlayStation Game of the Year nominee

technicalSpecs.engine: Capcom proprietary pre-rendered background 3D character engine
technicalSpecs.soundChip: PlayStation SPU 24-channel audio with Dolby Surround encoding
